Recruit mercenaries, train them and send them up a 999-floor tower in this auto-battle guild manager. You are the leader. A tower connects worlds. Application Description

Titan Quest has captivated legions of players since its 2006 debut. You get the all-encompassing experience of an unbridled, truly heroic journey through the worlds of Titan Quest! Your honorable quest is to save the world! The gods alone cannot defeat the Titans, so real heroes are needed - and that can only be you! Your success or failure will decide the fate of the people and the Olympians! With your custom-created hero, scour the mystical and ancient worlds of Greece, Egypt, Babylon, and China. Conquer the hordes of legendary creatures and master various weapons and martial arts: Archery, sword fighting, or the use of powerful magic! Travel a world of antiquity and Nordic mythology! Battle the beasts of mythology as you travel to the Parthenon, the Great Pyramids, the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, the Great Wall, the Tartarus Arena, and other famous places. Encounter the greatest villains of Greek mythology, discover the uncharted lands of northern Europe, search for the mythical kingdom of Atlantis, and set out on a journey across the western Mediterranean. It’s all or nothing on your glorious path! With each challenge that awaits you, you'll have to defeat bigger and stronger enemies until you reach your goal and force the Titans to their knees! Rush into battle alongside brave pet companions! Find extraordinary items with special powers that will enhance your abilities and help you on your path. Legendary swords, powerful lightning spells, magical, bows and numerous other treasures with unimaginable powers await you - all of them are at your disposal in your battles and spread fear and terror among the hideous creatures! What are you waiting for? Like no other game in the Action RPG genre, Titan Quest: Legendary Edition combines the fascinating world of mythology with endless and exciting action that you would expect from such a compelling game! Features: + Within the world of the Immortal Throne DLC, you’ll encounter the greatest villains of Greek mythology, brave the attacks of Cerberus, and hazard the banks of the River Styx. You have to interpret the prophecies of the blind seer Tiresias, fight alongside Agamemnon and Achilles, and use the wiles of Odysseus to conquer this dark new adventure. + In the uncharted lands of northern Europe in the Ragnarök DLC, you’ll brave the realms of the Celts, the Northmen, and the Asgardian gods! + Meet an explorer in the Atlantis DLC, in search of the mythical kingdom of Atlantis. A key is supposedly hidden in the diary of Herakles, which is rumored to be located in the Phoenician City of Gadir. Set out on a journey across the western Mediterranean, including the Tartarus Arena for epic battles! + All important updates have been implemented to the technically overhauled Titan Quest to grant the best gaming experience of this classic ever! + ETERNAL EMBERS DLCs available as in-app purchase - Summoned by the legendary Emperor Yao, the Hero is called back into the East to deal with a demonic threat that has been ravaging the land after the Telkine was slain. ! A note for all players who own the base version of Titan Quest: The DLCs mentioned here are also available for purchase as additional content so that all fans can upgrade their game to fully enjoy all expansions! © www.handy-games.com GmbH

Application Description

Dive into a deep story of corruption, crime and intrigue. Take the role of gritty Police Chief Jack Boyd, and come face to face with the ugly underbelly of Freeburg, a city spiraling the drain. Will Jack reach his retirement with a nice stack of bills, or will he end up broken ... or worse? Manage your staff, respond to emergencies, and investigate crimes in a city on the brink of chaos. The mafia underworld maneuvers behind the scenes, sinking their claws ever deeper into the city, even as the mayor is ready to exploit every situation to his political advantage. Choose your approach to each situation as it unfolds. Sometimes you’ll be responding to a developing crisis at a crime scene, or negotiating with Freeburg’s crime bosses. Sometimes you’ll find yourself dodging questions in the press room, or even the occasional cross-examination in the witness box. Can you keep this pressure cooker from exploding, at least for long enough to stash away a nice retirement nest egg? - Your mission is clear: make $500,000 in 180 days before Jack Boyd reaches retirement. How? That’s up to you! - Decisions, decisions! This Is the Police is all about a dark story and how you react to it. Whatever you decide, your choices will influence the game – and the fate of Jack Boyd. - The Good, the Bad, and... the Ugly? The Chief of Freeburg's Police Department deals with all kind of people. It is up to you to find the bad guys and decide how to deal with them. - Carry out your duties. As head of Freeburg PD, Jack deals with all sorts of challenges every day: responding to emergencies, managing his officers, defending the department against City Hall and a corrupt mayor, and much more. - Solve Investigations and gather evidence against the criminal gangs of Freeburg. - Deal with the competing powers of the city. Everyone offers you favors, and each one comes at a price. Rich and fully voiced story: Jack Boyd is portrayed by Jon St. John, the voice of Duke Nukem.

Application Description

We’re a small independent group of photographers, designers, and engineers who want more out of their camera: more natural shots, more cinematic video, and more manual controls. We’ve been making MPC-II for over a decade and promise to keep making it better. Join us. NATURAL, UNPROCESSED SHOTS It starts with the look. • MPC-II offers our own Natural Processing imaging pipeline. It builds from RAW data instead of the stock camera’s heavier HDR and contrast, so you get authentic tones without excessive sharpening and noise reduction. • Dynamic Range Enhancer: a tone mapping pipeline for Natural that recovers detail in highlights and shadows. Set it to Off, Light, Medium, or Strong. • Import Your LUTs: bring your own into the Look Library and organize them in folders. Shoot with your LUTs baked into your shots, or use them in preview-only mode. YOUR OWN WORKFLOW Your camera, your way. We built MPC-II to support anyone’s workflow. • Swap Your Action Plates: pick the plate that suits you, then choose which controls live on it. Rearrange the controls or remove everything but the capture mode. • Save Your Profiles: save your capture mode, format, look, and controls. Store unlimited profiles and pin four to quick slots you switch with a tap. • Launch From Anywhere: open a Profile or capture mode from a widget, a Shortcut, or Apple Watch. On the Watch you also get a live feed, lens switching, Crown zoom, and timers. • Your Focal Lengths: add the focal lengths you actually shoot to each camera and cycle through them from the lens bar. • Zen Mode: go distraction-free. PRO TOOLS Now for the camera-nerd features. We’ve spent a decade building pro tools that photographers and filmmakers rely on. Missing one? Tell us and we’ll add it. • All The Manual Controls: Auto, Shutter Priority with ISO range, ISO priority, or full Manual. White balance by temperature and tint, presets, or gray card. Separate exposure and focus reticles, Manual Focus, Focus Peaking, and Focus Loupe. On iPhone 18 Pro, Variable Aperture from f1.48 to f4.0. Works in Photo and Video. • Photo Modes: Natural, Standard, RAW, or ProRAW. JPG, HEIF, or TIFF. Standard at 12, 24, or 48MP. Shoot 3:4, 4:5, 1:1, or 16:9. Tune ProRAW bit depth and compression. • Video Modes: Open Gate, Apple Log and Log2, ProRes, 10-bit recording, and HEVC. Set resolution, color space, frame rate, codec, bitrate, and chroma subsampling. • Slow Shutter: build light trails and motion blur in camera by stacking frames. Set a duration, or hold the exposure open with Bulb. • Monitoring: Waveform, RGB histograms, zebras, false color, and audio meters. Grids, levels, and social frames. • Hardware and Storage: save to your photo library, Files, or external storage. Supports external and bluetooth mics, HDMI clean feed, and Moment lenses with anamorphic de-squeeze. BUILT TO BE RELIED ON We track our performance closely. Whether you’re shooting from a mountaintop or making a feature film, MPC-II is an app you can count on when it matters most. • Efficient processing: our pipeline is built to perform, even when shooting high-bandwidth formats with monitors and LUTs. • Confidence: your selected lens is locked, rather than switching on its own when the light changes. Your format, exposure, and color settings stay on screen, so you always know what you're shooting. • Always reliable: a stable app you can count on through the whole take, the whole shoot, and the whole trip. We love hearing from our community. For feature requests, ideas, or support, email us at hello@momentprocamera.com or message us @momentprocamera on social media. Application Description

Groundwire: the SIP softphone for your PBX or VoIP provider Groundwire is a SIP softphone app from Acrobits, a leader in VoIP and communication software since 2009. It delivers clear voice and video calls for personal and professional use, with an interface built for daily calling and none of the clutter. IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ Groundwire is a SIP client, not a VoIP service. You need service from a VoIP provider or PBX that supports standard SIP clients. Business calling features Groundwire carries the call handling you expect from a desk phone: - Group calls, for conferencing several people into one conversation. - Attended transfers, so you can announce a caller before handing the call over. - Unattended transfers, when the caller just needs the right extension. - Voicemail with notifications, so a missed call still reaches you. - Instant messaging, for the things that do not need a call. - Per-account settings, so one device carries several SIP identities cleanly. Works with your PBX or VoIP provider Groundwire is a universal client and true VoIP for PBX users. Teams run it as an Asterisk softphone, a FreePBX extension, or a 3CX endpoint, and it connects just as readily to hosted PBX systems and business phone providers. It also comes preconfigured for major providers, so setup takes minutes. A softphone app without the fees Groundwire is a softphone for calling over WiFi and mobile data, with the business dialer features that usually cost a monthly fee. One payment, no subscription, nothing hidden: buy it once and it stays yours. Encryption sits inside that price rather than on top of it. Run a call center, manage a fleet of extensions, or keep a dependable sip phone for a home office. The same app covers all of it, without extra tiers. The Republic of Galbadia, under the influence of the sorceress Edea, mobilizes its great armies against the other nations of the world.
